g.text: Technically, a Kimball data warehouse is a collection of

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: relational tables structured into a Dimensional Model

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (most commonly a Star Schema), which consists of exactly

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Fact Tables: Positioned at the center of the "star,"

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: these tables store the numerical metrics and quantitative

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: measurements resulting from a business event (e.g.,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Dimension Tables (Dims): Surrounding the fact table,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: these tables store the descriptive context (the Who, What,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Where, When, and Why) of the business event (e.g.,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Technically, an Inmon data warehouse is a centralized relational database

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: engineered in Third Normal Form (3NF). It decouples operational data from

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: analytical reporting through a strict multi-tier pipeline:

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. The Staging Area: Raw data lands from your source applications (CRMs,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. The Core Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW): Raw data is cleaned,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: integrated, and completely normalized into 3NF. This means data is split

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: into hundreds of thin, highly structured, interconnected tables to

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: eliminate any data redundancy (no repeated values across tables).

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. The Data Mart Layer: Department-specific data slices (like Sales or

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Finance) are built out of the central 3NF warehouse. These dependent data

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: marts are often flattened out into Kimball-style dimensional models so that

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: business users can easily run reports.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Technically, a Data Vault is a database modeling

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: methodology that splits data into three distinct,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: alphanumeric Hash Keys (e.g., MD5 or SHA-256) for

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Hubs: Relational tables that store only the unique

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Business Keys (identity markers like Customer_ID or

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Invoice_Num). They never store descriptive attributes or

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Links: Relational association tables that map the

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Satellites: Append-only relational tables connected to

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Hubs or Links that store all the descriptive properties,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: contexts, and state metrics (e.g., names, prices, values).

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: They preserve full history by inserting a new row with a

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: new Load_Timestamp whenever data changes, rather than

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The Raw Vault sits directly after your staging area. Its only job is to break raw

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: incoming data apart into Hubs, Links, and Satellites and save it permanently.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Saves Everything: If a source database sends a sale with a negative price or a

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: missing customer name, the Raw Vault saves it exactly that way. It does not judge or

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Provides Legal Auditing: Because it is never edited, a financial auditor can look

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: at the Raw Vault 5 years from now and see the exact, unaltered data your company

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Enables High-Speed Loading: Because it does not stop to calculate or clean

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: anything, data pipelines can stream millions of rows into it at blindingly fast

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The Business Vault is a sparse, optional layer that sits on top of the Raw Vault. It

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is where data engineers apply "soft" business rules to prepare the data for human

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Cleans and Standardizes: It fixes formatting issues (e.g., converting "N/A",

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: "null", and empty strings into a standard blank field, or forcing all strings to

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Applies Business Logic: It calculates metrics that the business cares about but

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: weren't in the raw systems (e.g., calculating Total_Profit = Revenue - Cost).

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Simplifies Complex Timelines: It uses special performance tables called PIT (Point-

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: in-Time) or Bridge tables. These tables pre-calculate exactly which rows across

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: different Satellites match up on a specific date, making it incredibly fast to build

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Kimball-style reporting views on top of them.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
